'''Azil Mareed''' was the High Captain of the [[Tower Guard]] around the time of the [[Aiel War]].{{Ref/book|0|2}} 

==History==
He was adviser to [[Marya Somares]], the [[White Tower]]'s representative on the council of the [[Grand Alliance]], but was not actually on the council himself.{{ref|{{bwb}}}} He sent reports to [[Tamra Ospenya]] at regular intervals, but the contents were not shared with anyone but full sisters, if even with them.
